widgetMetadata.instructions: Each entry under `widgets` describes one chart/widget rendered on this page of the Israeli Ecosystem dashboard. Descriptions are result-agnostic: they explain what the visualization shows and how to interpret it, not the specific numbers. The `dataPaths` array on each entry lists dot-notation paths inside this same JSON file where the underlying data for that widget lives (e.g. "kpis.patentingStartups" or "ipIntensity.items") When summarizing or answering questions about a number from this snapshot, locate the relevant widget(s) by `dataPaths` and quote the corresponding `description` to explain the metric. Widgets that have a 10 year trend usually show the total overall (across all years) and you get the exact data for each year in the past 10 years. The 10 year data do not add up to the total of course

startups:map.title: Israel Startup Map
startups:map.description: Geographic distribution of Israeli startups by their registered address in Israel. Each city marker is sized by the number of startups with an active legal registration in that city and colored by its administrative district. The legend lists the same totals by district. Only startups with a known registered Israeli address appear.

startups:kpi-total-startups.title: Total Startups
startups:kpi-total-startups.description: Total number of Israeli startups in the dataset (active, exited, and closed combined). The bar chart shows new startups by founding year over the past 10 years.

startups:kpi-funding-rounds.title: Funding Rounds
startups:kpi-funding-rounds.description: Total number of equity rounds raised by Israeli startups across all time: money paid into the company for newly issued shares, from pre-seed through late stage, including SAFEs, convertible notes and bridges. The bar chart shows the count of rounds closed each year over the past 10 years.

startups:kpi-total-raised.title: Total Raised
startups:kpi-total-raised.description: Total capital (USD) Israeli startups raised in equity rounds: money paid into the company for newly issued shares, from pre-seed through late stage, including SAFEs, convertible notes and bridges. The bar chart shows the dollar amount raised each year over the past 10 years.

startups:kpi-acquisitions.title: Acquisitions
startups:kpi-acquisitions.description: Total number of Israeli startups that exited via a completed acquisition, meaning a deal that actually went ahead. The bar chart shows acquisitions by exit year over the past 10 years.

startups:kpi-ipos.title: IPOs
startups:kpi-ipos.description: Total number of Israeli startups that exited via IPO and reached the market, meaning shares priced or trading on a public exchange. The bar chart shows IPOs by exit year over the past 10 years.

startups:kpi-time-to-exit.title: Time to Exit
startups:kpi-time-to-exit.description: Average number of years between founding year and exit year (acquisition or IPO) across all exited Israeli startups. The histogram shows the distribution of those exit times in 1-year buckets, capped at 30+ years.

startups:survival-distribution.title: Survival Distribution
startups:survival-distribution.description: Breakdown of all Israeli startups by current status: Active (still operating), Closed (shut down or dissolved), and Exit (acquired or went public). The center of the donut shows the total number of startups, or the value of the hovered slice.

startups:exit-funnel.title: Exit Funnel
startups:exit-funnel.description: How many Israeli startups make it through each progressive milestone toward an exit: All startups (everyone in the dataset), Funded (raised at least one equity round), $1M+ (raised at least $1 million in total), $10M+ (raised at least $10 million in total), Exit (a completed acquisition or public listing). The percentage on each segment is the retention from the All-startups stage.

startups:time-to-exit.title: Time To Exit
startups:time-to-exit.description: Average and median number of years between founding year and exit year (acquisition or IPO) across all exited Israeli startups. The histogram below shows the distribution of those exit times in 1-year buckets, with the rightmost bucket capturing every exit at 30 or more years.

startups:industry-mix.title: Industry Share Over Time
startups:industry-mix.description: Stacked bar chart of the industry mix of Israeli startups by founding year. Each bar is one year, broken into 6 industry categories (IT and Telecom, Healthcare and Food, Consumer Goods and Services, Energy and Utilities, Financial Services, Media and Entertainment). Sub-industries that fall outside these 6 are bucketed into Unknown and excluded from the visible mix. The legend on the right shows each industry overall total and share across all years.

startups:signal-deeptech.title: Deeptech
startups:signal-deeptech.description: Share of Israeli startups flagged as deeptech. Deep tech companies require significant resources, long development cycles, specialized expertise, and substantial investment. The 10-segment meter visualizes that share. The number on the right is the absolute count of deeptech startups.

startups:signal-global.title: Operating Globally
startups:signal-global.description: Share of Israeli startups that have a product with a global audience. The 10-segment meter visualizes that share. The number on the right is the absolute count of globally operating startups.

startups:trending-up.title: Sub-Industries Trending Up By Share Of Total
startups:trending-up.description: Top 5 sub-industries whose share of new Israeli startups has grown the most over the past 10 founding years. Each line is one sub-industry. The value at year Y is the share of startups founded in year Y whose primary sub-industry falls in that group. The dashed tail marks the most recent year, which is still incomplete.

startups:trending-down.title: Sub-Industries Trending Down By Share Of Total
startups:trending-down.description: Top 5 sub-industries whose share of new Israeli startups has shrunk the most over the past 10 founding years. Each line is one sub-industry. The value at year Y is the share of startups founded in year Y whose primary sub-industry falls in that group. The dashed tail marks the most recent year, which is still incomplete.

startups:feed-funding.title: Funding Feed
startups:feed-funding.description: Latest funding rounds added to the dataset, gathered from multiple verifiable sources. Unlike the headline funding figures, this feed carries every round type, grants and venture debt included, each one flagged with isNonEquity so you can tell them apart.

startups:feed-new-startups.title: New Startups
startups:feed-new-startups.description: Latest startups added to the dataset. Not necessarily new Startups founded.

startups:feed-notable.title: Notable Events
startups:feed-notable.description: Latest notable events gathered form news feeds, including acquisitions, IPOs, corporate events, strategic partnerships and more.

Mobile vocabulary learning application that helps users memorize words for entry exams using spaced repetition, personal mnemonics and progress tracking.
Online cosmetics brand selling makeup, skincare and beauty accessories directly to consumers through its own e-commerce store.

Digital health company providing diabetes and chronic condition management through a mobile app, connected glucose monitoring hardware, coaching, and AI powered predictions for personalized self care.
Luxury fashion house designing and producing handcrafted couture bridal gowns and evening wear for weddings and formal events.
Early-stage deep-tech company developing autonomous aerial systems for defence and dual-use applications, based in Israel.

Cloud-based gift commerce platform that enables retailers to offer frictionless digital and in-store gifting at checkout, allowing gift buyers to purchase without knowing product details or recipient shipping addresses.
Designs and sells natural bird toys for parrots, focused on safety and enrichment, with decorative designs suited to the home.

Music technology and sound design company producing royalty-free sample packs, MIDI files, synth presets and VST plugins for electronic music production, alongside mixing and mastering services and production courses.

Mobile proximity application that turns smartphones into people radars, helping users discover nearby people and social content matching their interests and needs, bridging online social networks with real-world encounters
AI meeting agent that records online and in person meetings, transcribes them, and generates notes, tasks, key decisions, and client ready deliverables for professional services teams.

Online Jewish dating and matchmaking platform that pairs singles with a network of human matchmakers who select and send curated matches instead of allowing members to browse profiles. It also hosts in-person and online singles events for members.

Children's social-emotional coaching program that uses filmmaking and mentorship workshops to build life skills, confidence and purpose in children aged 4 to 11, delivered online worldwide and through in-person mentorship programs.

AI-powered passive time tracking platform for legal professionals that automatically captures billable work from email, calendar and cloud drive integrations, categorizes entries by client and matter, and generates invoices from logged hours.

Price comparison website that compares cellular, internet, television, triple play and electricity packages and connects interested users with a single chosen service provider or its authorized marketer for a fee per referral.

AI platform that transforms unstructured media and behavioral data into actionable insights for investment, risk and operational decisions. It provides narrative based indicators and analytics to institutional investors and financial professionals.

Lifestyle fashion brand creating pop-culture-inspired apparel, phone cases, bags and accessories with playful graphic designs. It sells directly to consumers online and through retail stores internationally.

Made to order 14K gold jewelry with lab grown diamonds and a moissanite line, sold online to consumers in Israel. The company also operates an internal system for managing orders, inventory and stones, with a business portal for traders, jewelry stores and suppliers.
SaaS platform providing SEO keyword research, backlink analysis, competitor research and URL classification APIs for website optimization teams.

Embedded security platform for AI agent workloads, providing kernel-level enforcement that analyzes firmware images and system snapshots to produce software component inventories, SBOMs and vulnerability assessments, and enforces security policies at the syscall level where autonomous agents run.

notable.summary: Launched Asset-Level Reporting, Launch No.7 in the Season of Innovation, letting customers track and report individual assets alongside investments in one place.
Blockaid partnered with Houdini Swap to bring real-time token scanning to its private cross-chain swaps, flagging honeypots, rugpulls, and impersonation tokens before users swap.

Launched the Base44 Compliance API, connecting an Enterprise workspace to the security platforms a company already uses so security teams can see every app, AI agent, integration, member and role in the workspace alongside the rest of their SaaS. Live at launch with Orca Security (the design partner), Token Security and Noma Security, with Upwind, Pluto and Zenity coming soon.
Published ReplicaHeist research disclosing that Azure's object replication feature can be turned into a quiet cross-tenant data exfiltration or poisoning channel.

Announced that CEO Vincent Erenst agreed to extend his tenure at the request of the Supervisory Board, and that CFO Jean-Charles Valette intends to step down, remaining in role through 31 January 2027 while a successor is sought.
Tanium joined OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program, applying OpenAI GPT Cyber Models to threat research, vulnerability and remediation research, and the security of the Tanium platform.

Antseed introduced lANTS, an NFT representing a staked ANTS position. The lANTS keeps staked ANTS liquid: it can unlock free AI from the backed provider, earns weekly staking rewards, and can be moved between providers, split, merged or sold on community marketplaces such as antseedmarkets and lANTS Market.

Duane Mancini, M.Sc. (CEO and Co-Founder of Project Medtech, host of the Project Medtech Podcast) appointed to the epm Therapeutics Board of Directors, announced by the company. He brings experience in regulatory strategy, clinical trial design and commercialization for medical technology, and will advise as EPM301 advances toward clinical development for Prader-Willi syndrome hyperphagia.
Marine Tours and HyperGuest opened a direct route between hotels and B2B buyers.

42AI came out of stealth with the launch of its transformer-based behavioral world model (Large Behavioral Model) that predicts human decisions and behavior, focused on financial markets. The model was already screening trades for 10 large brokerages and generating seven-figure revenue at launch.

Released its largest platform update since launch: citation forecasting for 7/30/90-day horizons, a Site Auditor with 600+ AIO/AEO/GEO checks, keyword recommendations, a Content Manager workflow from draft to publication, MCP access (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed), publishing integrations (WordPress, Medium, Wix, Dev.to, headless API), seven report languages and a daily-updating AI Visibility Badge.

Reported 12-month Phase 2 data for Allocetra in knee osteoarthritis: in patients aged 64 and older, 79.2% achieved a clinically meaningful response (reduced pain and improved knee function) versus 47.6% on placebo at 12 months (p=0.027), with the treatment benefit consistent with 3- and 6-month results, demonstrating a durable effect from a single treatment cycle.

Reported record Q3 2026 results: revenue of $526 million (up 33% year over year), record gross profit of $179 million and record net profit of $120 million (excluding non-recurring items), and guided Q4 2026 revenue to $600 million, closing 2026 at approximately $2 billion annual revenue.
Launched Agentic Pen Testing, which tests live applications the way an attacker would and connects validated findings to remediation workflows.
A creditor vote on Papaya's revised repayment proposal was scheduled in the Tel Aviv-Jaffa District Court for November 8, 2026, with the Israeli court stay set to expire on November 25, 2026.

Launched the Any.do MCP integration (beta), letting compatible AI assistants such as ChatGPT connect to Any.do to add tasks, schedule reminders, run bulk actions and manage team work via Model Context Protocol.

Launched Agent Inbox, giving AI agents their own identity on email, Telegram and Slack with human-in-the-loop ask, approve, choose and notify flows, an MCP server, and a listen command that starts Claude Code sessions from incoming messages.

VAST 5.5 greatly extended the VAST Event Broker, the Kafka implementation built on the DASE architecture, with major performance gains (about 2GB/s sustained per node), new blob expansion (Topics to Tables) so streaming JSON is immediately queryable, mTLS authentication, and a maximum message size of 950MB.
Released Synch version 6.12, adding a redesigned Admin interface, a Reporting and Analytics Dashboard, enhanced SOS emergency conference workflow, Incident Checklists and Scheduled Incidents.
Duda launched Marketing Automation, a feature set to engage customers, drive sales and grow businesses on sites built on the platform.
